notes:
Summary: Mid-market sales engagement SaaS. Primary interest = replace existing rule-based outbound assistants with streaming LLM-powered SDR agents that can call tools: CRM update, create calendar invites, draft/send emails. Evaluating Hosted API first for speed of integration; likely to shift to Dedicated if predictability/throughput needs grow.

Requirements & targets (from product/eng):
- Latency SLO: p95 end-to-end streaming response <= 250ms for interactive stream chunks; initial POC target <= 300ms.
- Tool-calling: must support idempotent CRM writes, async calendar invites, safe email send (consent flow). Need server-side function/tool calls or webhook model.
- Concurrency: simulate 150-300 concurrent agent sessions during peak outbound bursts. Expected steady-state ~75 RPS token-generation, burst to 300 RPS.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market ARR; wants clear per-session unit economics. Concerned about per-token surprise charges when streaming + tool calling.
- Model preferences: prefer 8B-13B quantized variants for latency/cost tradeoff; open to Redwood-recommended curated models.
- Security: SSO (SAML), audit logs of tool-calls, retention controls for drafts, KMS integration required for customer-managed keys.

POC plan: 2-week sandbox + integration. Week1: integrate streaming API + tool-calls, connect to staging CRM and calendar. Week2: simulate load + measure latency/p95, run small pilot with 3 SDRs. Deliverables: perf runbook, cost projection, canary deployment playbook.

Quotes / call notes:
- "We need the agent to feel real-time — anything over ~300ms and reps notice the lag" — Head of Product (Maria Ortega) on 2026-02-12 demo.
- "Tool calls must be auditable; we can't have silent sends without audit trail" — Security lead (Tom Riley).

Open items / asks for Redwood:
- Dedicated vs Hosted cost comparison for sustained 100k monthly tokens + burst profile.
- Confirmation that streaming p95 targets are achievable with prefix caching and continuous batching enabled.
- Example audit log sample for tool-call events and retention TTL options.
- NDA amendment for outbound email automation (legal needs example language).
